spans.s:
Mūta in the later Saṃhitās and the Brāhmaṇas denotes a ‘woven basket.’ Mūtaka means a ‘small basket.’
Foot notes kāṭhaka Saṃhitā, xxxvi. 14; taittirīya brāhmaṇa, i. 6, 10, 5; Lāṭyāyana śrauta sūtra, viii. 3, 8.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, ii. 6, 2, 17.

Mūtiba appears in the aitareya brāhmaṇa as the name of one of the barbarous peoples enumerated as nominally Viśvāmitra's outcast offspring. The śāṅkhāyana śrauta sūtra gives the name as mūcīpa or mūvīpa.
Foot notes vii. 18, 2.
xv. 26, 6.
Cf. Muir, Sanskrit Texts, 12, 358, 483.
